body.statement: Under independent sampling, for every \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\in\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{IV}}\), \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\{Q_x^*(p_x)\subseteq\widehat{\mathcal Q}_{x,n}(\alpha)\text{ for all }x\in\mathcal X\}\geq1-\alpha\). The active-basis algorithm computes exactly the union in the definition, including zero-count cells and laws on intersections of optimal faces; the coverage statement is finite-sample and uniform over \(\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{IV}}\).
body.justification: Inference must cover the entire optimal correspondence, not an unstable selected optimizer.
body.gap: SongEtAl2026CategoricalIV covers simultaneous linear counterfactual functionals and ChernozhukovHongTamer2007Sets studies criterion-minimizer sets; neither gives exact finite-sample inversion for this coefficient-varying causal saddle correspondence.
body.consumer: A software implementation can return a certified set of all population-optimal mixtures even at face ties and with rare observed cells.
